mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO jysb_sbxx_001 () VALUES
(#{e.sbbh}, #{e.sbpp}, #{e.sbxh}, #{e.zblx}, #{e.ssgajgjgdm}, #{e.cphm}, #{e.jybh}, #{e.jyxm}, #{e.jysfz}, #{e.hh}, #{e.lxdh}, #{e.sbsyzt}, #{e.bz}, #{e.sjczlxdm}, #{e.sjly}, #{e.lrsj}, #{e.lrdwdm}, #{e.lrdwmc}, #{e.lrrxm}, #{e.lrrsfzh}, #{e.xgsj}, #{e.xgdwdm}, #{e.xgdwmc}, #{e.xgrxm}, #{e.xgrsfzh}, #{e.xxzjbh})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sbbh=VALUES(sbbh), sbpp=VALUES(sbpp), sbxh=VALUES(sbxh), zblx=VALUES(zblx), ssgajgjgdm=VALUES(ssgajgjgdm), cphm=VALUES(cphm), jybh=VALUES(jybh), jyxm=VALUES(jyxm), jysfz=VALUES(jysfz), hh=VALUES(hh), lxdh=VALUES(lxdh), sbsyzt=VALUES(sbsyzt), bz=VALUES(bz), sjczlxdm=VALUES(sjczlxdm), sjly=VALUES(sjly), lrsj=VALUES(lrsj), lrdwdm=VALUES(lrdwdm), lrdwmc=VALUES(lrdwmc), lrrxm=VALUES(lrrxm), lrrsfzh=VALUES(lrrsfzh), xgsj=VALUES(xgsj), xgdwdm=VALUES(xgdwdm), xgdwmc=VALUES(xgdwmc), xgrxm=VALUES(xgrxm), xgrsfzh=VALUES(xgrsfzh)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM jysb_sbxx_001 WHERE sjly = #{sjly}

SELECT t.*, loc.jd AS loc_jd, loc.wd AS loc_wd, loc.sbsyjssj AS loc_sbsyjssj FROM ( SELECT FROM jysb_sbxx_001 WHERE sjly = #{sjly} ORDER BY lrsj DESC, xxzjbh LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset} ) t LEFT JOIN jysb_sbxx_002 loc ON loc.sbbh = t.sbbh AND loc.xxzjbh = ( SELECT x.xxzjbh FROM jysb_sbxx_002 x WHERE x.sbbh = t.sbbh ORDER BY x.sbsyjssj DESC, x.lrsj DESC, x.xxzjbh DESC LIMIT 1 )
mapper.sql:
SELECT sbbh, MIN(sjly) AS sjly, MIN(zblx) AS zblx, MIN(jyxm) AS jyxm FROM jysb_sbxx_001
AND sjly LIKE CONCAT(#{sjly}, '%')
GROUP BY sbbh

SELECT d.sbbh, loc.jd, loc.wd, d.sjly FROM () d INNER JOIN jysb_sbxx_002 loc ON loc.xxzjbh = ( SELECT y.xxzjbh FROM jysb_sbxx_002 y WHERE y.sbbh = d.sbbh AND y.jd IS NOT NULL AND y.wd IS NOT NULL ORDER BY y.sbsyjssj DESC, y.lrsj DESC, y.xxzjbh DESC LIMIT 1 )
mapper.select:
SELECT d.sbbh, loc.jd, loc.wd, d.sjly, d.zblx, d.jyxm FROM () d
INNER JOIN jysb_sbxx_002_latest loc ON loc.sbbh = d.sbbh
INNER JOIN jysb_sbxx_002 loc ON loc.xxzjbh = ( SELECT y.xxzjbh FROM jysb_sbxx_002 y WHERE y.sbbh = d.sbbh AND y.jd IS NOT NULL AND y.wd IS NOT NULL ORDER BY y.sbsyjssj DESC, y.lrsj DESC, y.xxzjbh DESC LIMIT 1 )
WHERE loc.jd BETWEEN #{minLng} AND #{maxLng} AND loc.wd BETWEEN #{minLat} AND #{maxLat}

SELECT MIN(loc.jd) AS minLng, MIN(loc.wd) AS minLat, MAX(loc.jd) AS maxLng, MAX(loc.wd) AS maxLat FROM () loc WHERE loc.jd BETWEEN -180 AND 180 AND loc.wd BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND NOT (loc.jd = 0 AND loc.wd = 0)

SELECT t.region AS sbbh, AVG(t.jd) AS lng, AVG(t.wd) AS lat, COUNT(1) AS count FROM ( SELECT loc.jd, loc.wd, LEFT(loc.sjly, #{prefixLen}) AS region FROM () loc WHERE loc.sjly IS NOT NULL AND loc.sjly <> '' ) t GROUP BY t.region ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT loc.jd AS lng, loc.wd AS lat, 1 AS count, loc.sbbh AS sbbh, (SELECT d.jyxm FROM jysb_sbxx_001 d WHERE d.sbbh = loc.sbbh LIMIT 1) AS jyxm FROM () loc ORDER BY loc.sbbh LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT d.zblx AS zblx, COUNT(1) AS count FROM () loc INNER JOIN ( SELECT sbbh, MIN(zblx) AS zblx FROM jysb_sbxx_001 GROUP BY sbbh ) d ON d.sbbh = loc.sbbh GROUP BY d.zblx
